profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Cognosos
profile.summary: I am a software engineer with a strong systems background.  I have extensive experience with most flavors of Linux and I have a long history of build architect and IAM experience.  I’m a versatile person that picks up new technologies easily and adapts well to the fast pace of modern technology.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Team lead for backend services on a real-time asset tracking platform.
* Designed and built a Go backend that collects site data and turns it into training data for machine-learning models.
* Built and scaled a real-time GraphQL subscription service that streams Kinesis events to clients over WebSockets using a serverless Lambda and DynamoDB design
* Led root cause analysis and corrective actions for production incidents
* Designed load tests and break-fix tests for production services.
* Audited and maintained OpenAPI specs, OAuth2 scope documents, and published GraphQL schema docs.
* Improved API performance with pagination, N+1 query fixes, and query tuning.
* Remediated SOC2 audit findings and built safeguards to prevent recurrence.
* Managed builds and deployments using Jenkins, Docker, AWS Lambda, Fargate, and Step Functions.
* Helped build the team's AI-assisted development workflow, including automated quality gates, code review steps, test suites, and SOC2 compliance.
* On call and production support.
positions.insights: Skills: Go (Programming Language) · Python · REST · Software Development · Software Infrastructure · Software Design · DevOps · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · AWS Lambda · GraphQL · WebSocket · OpenAPI Specification (OAS)

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Team lead for all things IAM for the company's support and training portals as well as the new SaaS offering.
* In progress migration from Auth0 to Keycloak as the primary authentication system.
* In progress migration from Node microservices to Go microservices backed by Cassandra.
* OAuth2.0 and SAML support for the company.
* Worked with multiple groups across the company to integrate both internal and external systems with our IAM solutions.
* Designed and built a custom fine grained RBAC service in Go.
* Designed and implemented backend REST APIs for use by frontends.
* Designed an organization and team structure and common service that was the universal data model in use across all internal systems.
* Designed, built, and migrated a legacy custom authentication system written in Ruby on Rails to Auth0 backed by multiple microservices written in Node.
* Wrote and maintained a subscription microservice that acted as an interface between billing systems such as Salesforce and Recurly with internal systems.
* Managed deployments and configurations using Google GKE, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm.
* Wrote and supported Google Cloud Functions listening to Google Pub/Sub events that triggered changes in Salesforce, Zendesk, Skilljar, and other internal systems.
* On call support.
* Wrote and maintained support and training materials.
* Wrote helper scripts in Node, Ruby, and Go to help support the products.
positions.insights: Skills: Groovy · Auth0 · Go (Programming Language) · Keycloak · Cloud Computing · Node.js
